case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for setting out the cost drivers behind your quotation. Higher processing costs are a fair consideration, but the weighted calculation below supports a smaller adjustment than the increase requested.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +7.5%, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

A longer agreement offers you greater demand visibility in return for a lower, substantiated fixed price. We are flexible on the payment period; Option B retains your quoted payment terms, so please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We appreciate the straightforward discussion and look forward to continuing our partnership.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We have reviewed your weighted calculation and are prepared to extend the agreement to 24 months to provide you with greater demand visibility. However, for a 24-month duration, we must incorporate an AS-14404 index clause, as we cannot maintain a fixed price over this extended period. 

With this adjustment and keeping your preferred 30-day payment terms, we can revise our offer to EUR 5.51 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for reducing your offer and accepting a longer agreement; your need for alloy-cost protection over that term is understandable. We acknowledge that the verified delivery record does not change your calculation.

We are making a modest price concession and are flexible on indexation: Option B provides the alloy index clause you requested in exchange for a lower price. Option A retains a fixed price; please choose which approach works best, recognising that we expect a further price step from your side.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.29 per unit, fixed price, no index clause, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.24 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive engagement and look forward to agreeing a workable basis.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your message. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We appreciate your flexibility regarding the indexation and your understanding of our need for alloy-cost protection over the extended term. As our costs remain unchanged and we have already made a significant concession in our previous offer, we must maintain our price of EUR 5.46 for the 24-month agreement with the AS-14404 index clause and 90-day payment terms. 

To confirm our current position, our offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We believe this represents a fair and sustainable basis for our continued partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
